values.note: Drinking water from hand-pump wells; trash collection; day-use area with picnic tables, grills and a buoyed, ramp-accessible swim beach.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/huron-manistee/recreation/kneff-lake-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10218922 ('The campground provides handpump wells for drinking water, several vault toilets, and trash collection services'), read 2026-10-25

note: Huron NF campground on the far west side of the Mio Ranger District, east of Grayling, around 20-acre Kneff Lake (designated trout lake stocked with rainbow trout in spring; carry-in non-motorized boats only; buoyed swim beach at the day-use area). Site 9 is tent-only. Reached from M-72 via Stephan Bridge Rd and FR 4003; campground host on site in season. --Claude
